Sofie and the rest try to figure out how to survive until dawn, but one by one, they fall victim to a masked assailant. But one of them gets a glimpse of the man behind the mask, who forces the victim to look at a photograph of Irdina.

Indra and Seri do not believe in the supernatural and think that Dharma is making up all these things. In fact, Seri starts accusing Dharma of causing her twin to kill herself. One night, the man stops at the end of the tollgate area, staring at Maya's booth. Maya runs when the man approaches her. She falls and the man manages to injure her before he is shot by the police. Just before he dies, he tells Maya to return to her village. Months later, Maya and Dini are still struggling to survive. Maya decided to return to her village and seek help from her wealthy parents. Upon arrival in the rural, forested village, the villagers, led by Ki Saptadi, give her a cold reception.

programme.title: The Sharksons

programme.title: Digley & Dazey

programme.title: KiiYii
